title: RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer) 2025 Admit Card 2026 Out for 3225 Post
intro: Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has Officially Released Exam City/ Admit Card for The Post of 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer / Coach) Recruitment 2025-26 for 3225 Post. Exam Held On May 31 to June 11, 2026 & Admit Card Released On May 28, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Admit Card Now in the Given Link Below.
